whyRerun: The saved probe measured settingsVersion 15; the current instance reads settingsVersion 16. This new probe ran after the last observed settings change and after fixing terminal-formatted gcloud help parsing (EI-25944851128024249).

spec.behavior: The production Postgres instance refuses a client connection that does not use TLS.
spec.falsifier: A psql connection with sslmode=disable to the production instance authenticates and runs a query.

instrument.method: A throwaway e2-micro VM on the production subnet, with no service account or API scopes, connects to the private instance twice as portal_owner with the same deliberately wrong password. TLS is the only changed connection parameter. Pass requires plaintext refusal before authentication and the TLS control reaching password authentication.

observationTimestampBasis: Completion log mtime; the command exited 0. Instance identity and VM deletion were checked again after completion.
